newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 84-DAY T-BILLS YIELD 8.21 PERCENT AT TENDER.
newsitem.headline: NZ 84-DAY T-BILLS YIELD 8.21 PERCENT AT TENDER.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 84-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.21 percent versus 8.105 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for $75 million of 182-day Treasury bills was 7.991 percent versus 7.794 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 399-day treasury bills was 7.796 percent versus 6.713 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
